points: Survey of 637 US/UK researchers: 47% use AI daily; three in four report net savings averaging 6.9 hours a week
46% of those saving time spend over a quarter of it checking AI output; 41% report a growing backlog of untested hypotheses
49% say AI pushes them to more incremental questions, 28% to riskier ones; built on 360,000 Gemini science interactions
read: Working paper 'AI in Science: Early Insights' (Google, Google DeepMind, MIT FutureTech), September 2026, PDF
take: First large usage study of AI in research. Gains are real but self-reported, verification eats much of them, and AI nudges scientists toward safer questions.
title: Google: scientists save 7 hours a week with AI, then verify
